subset_multiple.sql: SELECT * FROM t MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PATTERN (A B C) SUBSET U = (A, B), V = (B, C) DEFINE A AS c > 1, B AS c > 2, C AS c > 3);

matched_and_condition.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.c = 'x' THEN DELETE;

matched_delete.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

matched_update.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c = s.c;

matched_update_and_condition.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.c > 0 THEN UPDATE SET c = s.c;

matched_update_multiple.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c = s.c, d = s.d;

multiple_when_clauses.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.c = 'x' THEN DELETE WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c = s.c WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, c) VALUES (s.id, s.c);

not_matched_and_condition.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.c > 0 THEN INSERT (id, c) VALUES (s.id, s.c);

not_matched_insert.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES (s.id, s.c);

not_matched_insert_columns.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, c) VALUES (s.id, s.c);

parenthesized_on.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON (t.id = s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

source_alias.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s AS src ON t.id = src.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

source_query.sql: MERGE INTO t USING (SELECT id, c FROM u) AS src ON t.id = src.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c = src.c;

target_alias.sql: MERGE INTO t AS tgt USING s ON tgt.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

target_alias_no_as.sql: MERGE INTO t tgt USING s ON tgt.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

target_branch.sql: MERGE INTO t @ audit USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

target_branch_alias.sql: MERGE INTO t @ audit AS tgt USING s ON tgt.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;

aggregation_alias_as.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) AS total FOR k IN (1 AS a, 2 AS b));

aggregation_alias_no_as.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) total FOR k IN (1 a, 2 b));

aggregation_expression.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) - sum(r) AS net FOR k IN (1 AS x));

aggregation_filter.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FILTER (WHERE c > 0) AS gains FOR k IN (1 AS x));

basic.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1, 2));

group_by.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a, 2 AS b) GROUP BY g);

group_by_cube.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a) GROUP BY CUBE (g, h));

group_by_empty.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a) GROUP BY ());

group_by_grouping_sets.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g), (h)));

group_by_multiple.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a) GROUP BY g, h);

group_by_rollup.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a) GROUP BY ROLLUP (g, h));

multi_column_pivot.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR (r, m) IN (('NA', 1) AS na_jan, ('EU', 1) AS eu_jan));

multi_column_tuple_no_alias.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR (r, m) IN (('NA', 1), ('EU', 1)));

multiple_aggregations.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) AS s, avg(c) AS a FOR k IN (1 AS x, 2 AS y));

nested_pivot.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a) GROUP BY g, m) PIVOT (sum(a) FOR m IN (1 AS x));

pivot_on_subquery.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT g, k, c FROM t) PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a));

relation_alias.sql: SELECT p.a FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN (1 AS a)) AS p;

relation_alias_columns.sql: SELECT p.r, p.jan, p.feb FROM sales PIVOT (sum(amount) FOR month IN (1 AS jan, 2 AS feb) GROUP BY region) AS p (r, jan, feb);

value_alias_as.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN ('a' AS x, 'b' AS y));

value_without_alias.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(c) FOR k IN ('a', 'b'));

delete.sql: PREPARE my_delete FROM DELETE FROM t WHERE a = ?;

insert.sql: PREPARE my_insert FROM INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 'x');

insert_parameters.sql: PREPARE my_insert FROM INSERT INTO t VALUES (?, ?);

select.sql: PREPARE my_select FROM SELECT * FROM t;

update.sql: PREPARE my_update FROM UPDATE t SET c = ? WHERE a = ?;

with_parameters.sql: PREPARE my_select FROM SELECT c FROM t WHERE a = ? AND b < ?;

all_privileges.sql: REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON t FROM u;

basic.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON t FROM u;

from_role.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON t FROM ROLE r;

from_user.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON t FROM USER u;

grant_option_for.sql: REVOKE GRANT OPTION FOR SELECT ON t FROM u;

multiple_privileges.sql: REVOKE INSERT, SELECT ON t FROM u;

on_branch.sql: REVOKE INSERT ON BRANCH b IN t FROM u;

on_schema.sql: REVOKE DELETE ON SCHEMA s FROM u;

on_table_keyword.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON TABLE t FROM u;

admin_option_for.sql: REVOKE ADMIN OPTION FOR r FROM u;

granted_by_current_role.sql: REVOKE r FROM u GRANTED BY CURRENT_ROLE;

granted_by_user.sql: REVOKE r FROM u GRANTED BY USER g;

in_catalog.sql: REVOKE r FROM u IN c;

multiple_roles_and_grantees.sql: REVOKE r1, r2 FROM USER u, ROLE r3;

cross_join_lateral.sql: SELECT name, x, y FROM nation CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name || ' :-' AS x) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x || ')' AS y);

except_corresponding.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'alice'), (2, 'bob')) AS t (id, name) EXCEPT CORRESPONDING SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('alice', 1)) AS t (name, id);

except_distinct.sql: SELECT a FROM t EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT a FROM u;

fetch_first_count_with_ties.sql: SELECT name, regionkey FROM nation ORDER BY regionkey FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS WITH TIES;

fetch_first_row_only.sql: SELECT orderdate FROM orders FETCH FIRST ROW ONLY;

fetch_first_rows_only.sql: SELECT orderdate FROM orders FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;

fetch_first_with_ties.sql: SELECT name, regionkey FROM nation ORDER BY regionkey FETCH FIRST ROW WITH TIES;

fetch_next.sql: SELECT orderdate FROM orders FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY;

from_match_recognize.sql: SELECT * FROM t MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b MEASURES MATCH_NUMBER() AS m ONE ROW PER MATCH PATTERN (A B+) DEFINE B AS b > PREV(b)) AS mr;

from_pivot.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT (sum(amount) FOR quarter IN ('Q1', 'Q2')) AS p;

from_subquery.sql: SELECT a, b FROM (SELECT a, MAX(b) AS b FROM t GROUP BY a) AS x;

from_table_alias_columns.sql: SELECT x FROM t AS a (x, y);

from_table_function.sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(my_function(1, 2)) AS f (x, y);

group_by_all_quantifier.sql: SELECT origin_state, destination_state, origin_zip, sum(package_weight) FROM shipping GROUP BY ALL CUBE (origin_state, destination_state), ROLLUP (origin_state, origin_zip);

group_by_auto.sql: SELECT mktsegment, sum(acctbal) FROM shipping GROUP BY AUTO;

group_by_combined.sql: SELECT origin_state, destination_state, origin_zip, sum(package_weight) FROM shipping GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((origin_state, destination_state)), ROLLUP (origin_zip);

group_by_cube.sql: SELECT origin_state, destination_state, sum(package_weight) FROM shipping GROUP BY CUBE (origin_state, destination_state);

group_by_distinct_quantifier.sql: SELECT origin_state, destination_state, origin_zip, sum(package_weight) FROM shipping GROUP BY DISTINCT CUBE (origin_state, destination_state), ROLLUP (origin_state, origin_zip);

group_by_empty.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t GROUP BY ();

group_by_expression.sql: SELECT count(*), nationkey FROM customer GROUP BY nationkey;

group_by_grouping_sets.sql: SELECT origin_state, origin_zip, destination_state, sum(package_weight) FROM shipping GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((origin_state), (origin_state, origin_zip), (destination_state));

group_by_ordinal.sql: SELECT count(*), nationkey FROM customer GROUP BY 2;

group_by_rollup.sql: SELECT origin_state, origin_zip, sum(package_weight) FROM shipping GROUP BY ROLLUP (origin_state, origin_zip);

grouping_operation.sql: SELECT origin_state, origin_zip, destination_state, sum(package_weight), grouping(origin_state, origin_zip, destination_state) FROM shipping GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((origin_state), (origin_state, origin_zip), (destination_state));

having.sql: SELECT mktsegment, nationkey FROM customer GROUP BY mktsegment, nationkey HAVING sum(acctbal) > 5700000;

intersect_all.sql: SELECT a FROM t INTERSECT ALL SELECT a FROM u;

intersect_corresponding.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'alice')) AS t (id, name) INTERSECT CORRESPONDING SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('alice', 1)) AS t (name, id);

join_cross.sql: SELECT * FROM nation CROSS JOIN region;

join_full.sql: SELECT * FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

join_inner.sql: SELECT * FROM a INNER JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

join_left.sql: SELECT * FROM a LEFT OUTER JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

join_natural.sql: SELECT * FROM a NATURAL JOIN b;

join_plain.sql: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

join_right.sql: SELECT * FROM a RIGHT JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

join_using.sql: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b USING (id, c);

json_table.sql: SELECT * FROM JSON_TABLE(j, 'lax $[*]' COLUMNS (a bigint PATH 'lax $.a')) AS jt;

limit_all.sql: SELECT orderdate FROM orders LIMIT ALL;

nearest_comma_join.sql: SELECT * FROM trades, NEAREST (FROM quotes MATCH quotes.ts > trades.ts);

nearest_cross_join.sql: SELECT trades.symbol, trades.ts, quotes.price FROM trades CROSS JOIN NEAREST (FROM quotes WHERE quotes.symbol = trades.symbol MATCH quotes.ts <= trades.ts);

nearest_inner_join.sql: SELECT * FROM trades INNER JOIN NEAREST (FROM quotes MATCH quotes.ts < trades.ts) ON TRUE;

nearest_left_join.sql: SELECT trades.symbol, quotes.price FROM trades LEFT JOIN NEAREST (FROM quotes WHERE quotes.symbol = trades.symbol MATCH quotes.ts >= trades.ts) ON TRUE;

offset.sql: SELECT name FROM nation ORDER BY name OFFSET 22;

offset_fetch.sql: SELECT name FROM nation ORDER BY name OFFSET 2 ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY;

offset_limit.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES 5, 2, 4, 1, 3) t (x) ORDER BY x OFFSET 2 LIMIT 2;

offset_row.sql: SELECT name FROM nation ORDER BY name OFFSET 1 ROW;

offset_rows.sql: SELECT name FROM nation ORDER BY name OFFSET 22 ROWS;

order_by.sql: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a;

order_by_asc_desc.sql: SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY a ASC, b DESC;

order_by_nulls.sql: SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY a NULLS FIRST, b DESC NULLS LAST;

order_by_ordinal.sql: SELECT n.name, r.name FROM nation AS n CROSS JOIN region AS r ORDER BY 1, 2;

select_alias_as.sql: SELECT a AS x, b y FROM t;

select_row_star_aliases.sql: SELECT (CAST(ROW(1, true) AS ROW(field1 bigint, field2 boolean))).* AS (alias1, alias2);

set_operation_parentheses.sql: SELECT a FROM t UNION (SELECT a FROM u INTERSECT SELECT a FROM v) EXCEPT SELECT a FROM w;

subquery_exists.sql: SELECT name FROM nation WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM region WHERE region.regionkey = nation.regionkey);

subquery_in.sql: SELECT name FROM nation WHERE regionkey IN (SELECT regionkey FROM region WHERE name = 'AMERICA' OR name = 'AFRICA');

subquery_scalar.sql: SELECT name FROM nation WHERE regionkey = (SELECT max(regionkey) FROM region);

tablesample_join.sql: SELECT o.*, i.* FROM orders o TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (10) JOIN lineitem i TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (40) ON o.orderkey = i.orderkey;

union_corresponding.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'alice')) AS t (id, name) UNION ALL CORRESPONDING SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('bob', 2)) AS t (name, id);

union_distinct.sql: SELECT a FROM t UNION DISTINCT SELECT a FROM u;

unnest_cross_join.sql: SELECT student, score FROM (VALUES ('John', ARRAY[7, 10, 9]), ('Mary', ARRAY[4, 8, 9])) AS tests (student, scores) CROSS JOIN UNNEST(scores) AS t (score);

unnest_left_join_on_true.sql: SELECT runner, checkpoint FROM (VALUES ('Joe', ARRAY[10, 20]), ('Levi', NULL)) AS marathon (runner, checkpoints) LEFT JOIN UNNEST(checkpoints) AS t (checkpoint) ON TRUE;

unnest_map.sql: SELECT * FROM UNNEST(map_from_entries(ARRAY[('SQL', 1974), ('Java', 1995)])) AS t (language, first_appeared_year);

unnest_with_ordinality.sql: SELECT a, b, rownumber FROM UNNEST(ARRAY[2, 5], ARRAY[7, 8, 9]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t (a, b, rownumber);

where.sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE a > 1 AND b < 2;

window_clause.sql: SELECT orderkey, clerk, totalprice, rank() OVER w AS rnk FROM orders WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY clerk ORDER BY totalprice DESC) ORDER BY count() OVER w, clerk, rnk;

window_clause_multiple_referencing.sql: SELECT rank() OVER w2 FROM t WINDOW w1 AS (PARTITION BY a), w2 AS (w1 ORDER BY b);

with_clause.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT a, MAX(b) AS b FROM t GROUP BY a) SELECT a, b FROM x;

with_function.sql: WITH FUNCTION hello(name varchar) RETURNS varchar RETURN format('Hello %s!', name) SELECT hello('Finn');

with_function_multiple.sql: WITH FUNCTION hello(name varchar) RETURNS varchar RETURN format('Hello %s!', name), FUNCTION bye(name varchar) RETURNS varchar RETURN format('Bye %s!', name) SELECT hello('Finn') || ' and ' || bye('Joe');

with_multiple.sql: WITH t1 AS (SELECT a FROM x), t2 AS (SELECT a FROM y) SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a;

with_recursive.sql: WITH RECURSIVE t(n) AS (VALUES (1) UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM t WHERE n < 4) SELECT sum(n) FROM t;

with_session.sql: WITH SESSION query_max_execution_time = '2h', example.query_partition_filter_required = true SELECT * FROM example.default.thetable LIMIT 100;

for_query.sql: SHOW STATS FOR (SELECT * FROM t WHERE x > 1);

isolation_read_uncommitted.sql: START TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
